title: Spices and Condiments - Large Cardamom - Capsules and Seeds
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies requirements and methods of test and sampling for large cardamom as capsules and seeds (Amomum subulatum Roxb.). 1.2 Recommendations relating to storage and transport are given in Annex A.
